data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step (timeanddate, then weather.com 10-day, then a mail draft to family@example.com with the same subject and body, then discard) and has the right city, relative and day parameters. Feasibility loses a point because it adds an unneeded "recipient" parameter, hardcodes "Lille" in the offset, and doesn't spell out the UI clicks (To, Subject and Body fields, Discard) or the tab switching.
